title: Nanoleaf Scene Usage Leaderboard by Week
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nanoleaf:scene event=scene_applied
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as activations by scene _time
| sort - activations
description: Uses Nanoleaf scene activations telemetry to monitor which scenes actually get used each week in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for stale scenes that can probably be retired, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Nanoleaf scene activations data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It frames which scenes actually get used each week so you can spot stale scenes that can probably be retired before it becomes annoying.
